body: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100× and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14× fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.
summaryZh: LiteRAG通过引入查询条件化的算法探索与推理链上下文构建，替代了传统高昂的LLM控制检索。在DistComp基准测试中，该方法在保持高质量回答的同时，将查询延迟降低了100倍以上，成本降低了99%。研究表明，通过查询自适应阈值与社区感知中心惩罚机制，可以有效解决图检索中上下文冗余与计算效率低下的问题，为大规模知识图谱的RAG应用提供了高效的解决方案。
